ian.h: ran into a UX bug in the Rust SDK where ApiError hides http status, so callers can't differentiate refreshable auth failures vs permission errors.
nina: Oh that explains our background worker loop hitting 403 and trying to refresh.
oliver: We should add small typed errors + fields: http_status, retry_after, and a short human_action hint. Keep ApiError as base for parity.
ian.h: example catch pattern: try { ... } catch (e) { if (e.http_status == 401) refresh(); else if (e.http_status == 429) sleep(e.retry_after); else throw; }
devex-bot: created DE-2033: "sdk: expose http_status + retry hints across sdks" assigned to @oliver
